articles.title: Sterling Anderson doesn’t think humanoid robots should be building cars
articles.description: At a splashy event in New York City last week, General Motors unveiled its new tech roadmap centered on AI-driven vehicle development, advanced battery tech, high-powered car computers, and autonomous driving.
